**The problem**
What are you trying to do that Silo doesn't support today?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see.

**Is this core or an extension?**
Silo keeps a small core and pushes features into extensions. If this could be an
extension built on the public [`ctx`](https://github.com/silo-code/silo/tree/main/apps/docs/api)
surface, say so — and note any `ctx`/SDK capability it would need that doesn't
exist yet.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything you've tried or ruled out.
